text:
anya: Quick async — we need a final call on the optkit quant defaults for this week's delivery. main points: FP16 vs 4-bit, whether to enable aggressive prefix/KV caching by default, and an initial batching policy. can owners confirm?
kevin: short answer — prefer 4-bit for the smaller models, FP16 for the large ones until we validate 4-bit regressions. want to document fallback to FP16 when quality drops.
sam: @kevin +1 on fallback. can we make the default per-model in the catalog config so it's not global? means ops teams can override per-deployment.
anya: yes, per-model defaults in catalog is the plan. rachel — any blockers from infra for enabling KV cache by default?
rachel: infra ok with KV cache default, but need a knob for prefix TTL and memory guardrails. suggest default TTL=30m and mem cap 40% of GPU RAM for cache.
kevin: that sounds sane. for quant we should keep `quant_profile: conservative` as default and expose `force_quant=4bit` opt-in for testing.
sam: documenting here the proposed config snippet — please eyeball: ```yaml
model_catalog:
  - name: llama-2-13b
    default_precision: fp16
    quant_profile: conservative
    caching:
      kv_ttl: 1800 # seconds
      kv_mem_pct: 40
    batching:
      strategy: latency-aware
      max_batch_tokens: 2048
```
rachel: looks good. nit: change `kv_ttl` comment to `30m` for readability. also we should set `max_batch_size` explicit for GPU scheduling, maybe 48 requests or 8k tokens whichever first.
anya: added to checklist: update catalog schema, add per-model override docs, and update Optimize tests to include a short eval for 4-bit regression on critical prompts. @kevin can you own the eval harness?
kevin: I can own the eval harness. timeline: draft tests by Wednesday, run on staging by Thursday. will add a tag `optkit-4bit-smoke` to make rollouts observable.
sam: I'll add an infra flag `enable_kv_default` and `kv_mem_pct` into deploy manifests so we can toggle per-region if needed.
rachel: deploy-bot rolled out a small change earlier, FYI — `kv-cache` image bumped to v1.3.2, no regressions in e2e so far. :thumbsup:
anya: great — small action list: 1) kevin: eval harness + smoke tests (due Wed) 2) sam: deploy manifest flags + rollout plan 3) anya: update catalog schema and docs 4) rachel: ensure memory guardrails and monitor charts. I'll follow up with a short PR template for rollout notes.
kevin: one more ask — can we include a quick perf baseline for tokens/sec on 4-bit vs fp16 in the PR? helps product tradeoffs.
sam: yep I'll include perf logs from staging runs.
rachel: I'll add alerts for error-rate and token latency regressions to the per-route dashboard.
anya: thanks team. if no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock these defaults and start the canary rollout. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deployment note: canary group A scheduled for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC if owners confirm.
